Actual result: Class grant applied to both currently enrolled students in the end-to-end test; rule harness also confirmed roster update.

Procedure: One student already has INDIVIDUAL extension before class grant
Expected result: Individual deadline and scope remain unchanged; other students receive class deadline
Actual result: A prior individual extension was preserved during the class grant; the other enrolled student received the class deadline.

Procedure: Assigned lecturer grants extension when no students are enrolled
Expected result: Clear validation error; no database write
Actual result: The function rejected an empty class and made no extension changes.

Procedure: Student opens assignment list after class grant
Expected result: Effective deadline and Class extension label are visible
Actual result: After process restart, Student B saw the revised class deadline and Class extension label.

Procedure: Assigned lecturer grants a later class extension again
Expected result: Existing CLASS rows update atomically; individual exceptions remain intact
Actual result: Later class extension updated CLASS rows; earlier/shorter class deadline was rejected; INDIVIDUAL exception was retained.

Procedure: Lecturer grants an individual extension after class grant
Expected result: Selected student deadline changes and scope becomes INDIVIDUAL
Actual result: Lecturer issued an individual extension after the class grant; Student A saw Individual extension with the individual deadline.

Actual result: Rule test accepted resubmission at the effective deadline and rejected a timestamp one second after it. Full console upload path not run.

Expected result: Extension scope and revised deadlines persist
